tools.name: page.navigate
tools.description: Navigate within plymove.com to an allowed path. Cross-origin URLs are rejected. Optional hash via path like /docs#mcp is accepted at runtime when path is /docs.

path.description: Site-relative path only. Allowed: /, /developers, /docs, /pricing, /contact, /status, /legal/privacy, /legal/terms. Optional hash (e.g. /docs#mcp).

tools.name: page.scroll_to_section
tools.description: Smooth-scroll the current page to a DOM element id (without #).

id.description: DOM element id, e.g. mcp, rest-api, buy-credits

tools.name: plymove.analyze_what_if
tools.description: Sync: analyze a user-requested alternative at a mainline decision point. Validates the exact SAN, compares to the played move, Stockfish continuation, Maia naturalness, legal RAV PGN. Pass pgn or analysis_id from a prior storyboard. Paid.

pgn.description: Full game PGN (or use analysis_id from a prior storyboard)

analysis_id.description: Storyboard analysis_id (sb_…) when PGN is omitted

anchor_ply.description: Mainline ply of the played move

alternative_move_san.description: Requested alternative in SAN — never auto-substituted

tools.name: plymove.build_game_storyboard
tools.description: Sync: build an Elo-aware game storyboard from a PGN (opening, arc, ranked chapters, main lesson). Calls mcp.plymove.com. Paid.

pgn.description: Full game in PGN (headers optional). Must include move text such as 1.e4 e5. Not a single FEN.

tools.name: plymove.compare_moves
tools.description: Sync: compare candidate SAN moves from a FEN for a learner Elo. Calls mcp.plymove.com. Paid (API key or x402). Distinct from explain_position (multi-move comparison).

fen.description: Chess position in standard FEN (six fields: piece placement, active color, castling, en passant, halfmove, fullmove).

items.description: One move in Standard Algebraic Notation (SAN), e.g. Nf3, exd5, O-O. Not UCI.

moves.description: Two or more candidate moves in SAN (not UCI).

tools.name: plymove.contact_sales
tools.description: Submit a sales/API-access contact request via the same /api/contact backend as the human form.

tools.name: plymove.explain_game
tools.description: Legacy alias → storyboard v2. Whole-game storyboard with optional rendered recap. Paid.

pgn.description: Full game in PGN (headers optional). Must include move text such as 1.e4 e5. Not a single FEN.

verbosity.description: Teaching moment density: minimal (~2–5 moments), standard (~3–12, default), detailed (~4–16+). Adjusts selection budget only.

tools.name: plymove.explain_position
tools.description: Sync: explain a chess position for a learner Elo (concepts, candidates, teaching value). Calls mcp.plymove.com. Paid (API key or x402). FEN required.

fen.description: Chess position in standard FEN (six fields: piece placement, active color, castling, en passant, halfmove, fullmove).

tools.name: plymove.find_teaching_moments
tools.description: Legacy alias → storyboard v2. Ranked chapters from a PGN. Optional verbosity controls chapter count. Paid.

pgn.description: Full game in PGN (headers optional). Must include move text such as 1.e4 e5. Not a single FEN.

verbosity.description: Teaching moment density: minimal (~2–5 moments), standard (~3–12, default), detailed (~4–16+). Adjusts selection budget only.

tools.name: plymove.get_access_info
tools.description: Return how to access PlyMove: MCP Streamable HTTP (API key or x402), REST endpoints with sync/async + poll contract, and the HTTP agent gateway. Never returns secrets.

tools.name: plymove.get_pricing
tools.description: Return structured public pricing: prepaid pack ($10 → 1000 units), x402 at 1.5× unit price, per-tool units, and pricing_page URL. Prefer this over navigating for price facts.

tools.name: plymove.get_product_info
tools.description: Return concise facts about PlyMove (pedagogical chess intelligence): purpose, capabilities, inputs, and high-level access modes.

tools.name: plymove.open_developer_docs
tools.description: Open PlyMove developer documentation (or pricing/developers/contact). Use get_pricing for price facts; use this to navigate humans/agents to docs sections.

section.description: Docs or site section to open
